title: Consistency Models
core_mech: 学习沿 PF-ODE 轨迹不变的 endpoint map，使任意噪声尺度可直接一步映射到 clean sample。
core_mech_en: Learns a self-consistent function f_θ(x_t, t) = x_ε that maps any point along a Probability-Flow ODE trajectory directly to its clean origin in a single step.
input_desc: 噪声状态 x_t；蒸馏模式下还需预训练 diffusion score teacher
input_en: Noisy state x_t along a PF-ODE trajectory (distilled from a pretrained score model or trained standalone)
output_desc: 一次或少数几次函数调用得到的 clean sample
output_en: One-step or few-step clean sample estimate x̂_0

source.title: Consistency Models
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

adapter.name: Consistency Models
adapter.mechanism: Shared-noise adjacent sigma pairs, a stop-gradient EMA target, and exact sigma_min boundary parameterization.
limitations: Fixed sixteen-level consistency-training grid and MSE; no pretrained diffusion distillation or original progressive schedule.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
